optimizedDescription.value: Pure domain models `Skill` and `SkillTemplate` — lazy content, no I/O.

optimizedContext.value:
# skills:skill

## Rules

### Skill interface
- `Skill` MUST be interface:
  - `name: string` — unique id
  - `description: string` — human-readable purpose
  - `kind: 'skill' | 'agent'`
  - `templates: SkillTemplate[]`

### SkillTemplate interface
- `SkillTemplate` MUST be interface:
  - `filename: string`
  - `getContent(): Promise<string>` — lazy load

### No I/O in domain
- Domain layer MUST NOT contain I/O (fs, network, etc.). I/O only in infrastructure.

### Lazy content loading
- Content MUST load lazily via `getContent()`. `Skill` MUST NOT hold loaded content in memory.

### Typed errors for skill operations
- Skill domain errors MUST use typed classes extending package-level base (e.g. `SpecdSkillsError`). Base MUST follow Specd Error Contract and extend `SpecdError` from `@specd/core`.

## Constraints

- Domain types MUST be pure TypeScript interfaces.
- No deps on `node:fs` or any I/O library.
